```{=html}

<script>
// ---- State ----
const S = {
  phase: 'instructions', nQuestions: 5, currentQ: 0,
  pairs: [], answers: [], displayOrder: [], revealed: [], confidences: [],
  selDifficulty: 'mixed', selNq: 5, seenKeys: new Set()
};
let quizPool = [];

// ---- Data ----
function loadData() {
  const el = document.getElementById('quiz-data');
  if (!el) return;
  quizPool = JSON.parse(el.textContent);
}

// ---- Security helpers ----
function escHtml(s) {
  return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function(c) {
    return {'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c];
  });
}
function safeHref(u) {
  u = String(u || '');
  if (/^(https?:\/\/|mailto:|\/|#)/i.test(u)) return u;
  return '#';
}

// ---- Helpers ----
function shuffle(arr) {
  const a = [...arr];
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
  }
  return a;
}
function formatName(name) { return name.replace(/\s*\(/, '<br>('); }
function fmtMM(v) {
  if (v >= 100) return Math.round(v).toLocaleString();
  if (v >= 1) return parseFloat(v.toFixed(1)).toString();
  if (v >= 0.01) return parseFloat(v.toFixed(2)).toString();
  return parseFloat(v.toFixed(3)).toString();
}
function renderQR(containerId, size) {
  const url = window.location.href.split('?')[0].split('#')[0];
  const el = document.getElementById(containerId);
  if (!el || typeof qrcode === 'undefined') return;
  const safeSize = Math.max(1, Math.min(20, parseInt(size, 10) || 3));
  const qr = qrcode(0, 'M');
  qr.addData(url);
  qr.make();
  const img = qr.createImgTag(safeSize);
  const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
  wrapper.className = 'qr-section';
  wrapper.innerHTML = img;
  const urlSpan = document.createElement('span');
  urlSpan.className = 'qr-url';
  urlSpan.textContent = url;
  wrapper.appendChild(urlSpan);
  el.innerHTML = '';
  el.appendChild(wrapper);
}
function selectInGroup(grpId, clicked) {
  const btns = document.getElementById(grpId).querySelectorAll('.option-btn');
  btns.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('selected'));
  clicked.classList.add('selected');
}

// ---- Leaderboard (pure JS, same as before) ----
const FORM_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc1HX5kPVO6G982zOxH2BLv1FWexiITPnbjfWMN3a1M9yDtvw/formResponse';
const SHEET_URL = 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17HLtIdV3r55dIh06cSaWT8kFXzNrkR-Fu2ZJkjszG8k/gviz/tq?tqx=out:json';
const STATS_URL = 'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/api/quiz_stats.json';
let scoreSubmitted = false;

function resetLeaderboard() {
  scoreSubmitted = false;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Submit Score'; btn.className = 'btn btn-lg'; btn.style.cssText = 'background:#b85c0a;color:#fff'; }
  const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  if (el) el.textContent = '';
}

// Mean confidence (0-100) across questions the participant rated in the
// CURRENT attempt. Returns null when no question was rated at all — the
// caller must guard on that and omit the field rather than send a bogus 0.
// The Google Form only accepts ONE confidence value per submission (no
// per-question repeat structure), so this attempt-level mean is the most
// granular thing that can be sent to the population Sheet; the real
// per-question confidences stay local (recordScoreHistory()/computeCalibration()).
function computeMeanConfidence() {
  const rated = S.confidences.filter(function(c) { return c !== null && c !== undefined; });
  if (rated.length === 0) return null;
  return rated.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / rated.length;
}

// ---- Per-question JSON payload builder (#183/#184) ----
// Serializes the full per-question detail for the just-completed attempt
// (question identity, the user's answer, correctness, per-question
// difficulty, and per-question confidence). Not yet wired into the live
// Form submission -- see the commented-out data.append(...) stub in
// submitScore() below -- ready the moment a real Google Form field exists
// to receive it (see #183).
function buildPerQuestionPayload() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  const payload = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const pair = S.pairs[i];
    const ans = S.answers[i];
    const conf = S.confidences[i];
    payload.push({
      q: pair.activity_a + ' vs ' + pair.activity_b,
      answer: ans === null ? null : pair['activity_' + ans],
      correct: ans !== null && ans === pair.answer,
      difficulty: pair.difficulty || null,
      confidence: (conf === null || conf === undefined) ? null : conf
    });
  }
  return JSON.stringify(payload);
}

function submitScore(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions) {
  if (scoreSubmitted) return;
  const btn = document.getElementById('submit_btn');
  if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Submitting...'; btn.className = 'btn btn-secondary btn-lg'; }
  const data = new URLSearchParams();
  const perQuestionJson = buildPerQuestionPayload();
  data.append('entry.601346678', perQuestionJson);
  const anonId = getAnonId();
  data.append('entry.201945648', anonId);
  data.append('entry.335579146', score);
  data.append('entry.2122920576', total);
  data.append('entry.621716914', new Date().toISOString());
  data.append('entry.268026248', 'acute');
  data.append('entry.232879816', difficulty || '');
  data.append('entry.2010782223', nQuestions || '');
  const meanConf = computeMeanConfidence();
  if (meanConf !== null) data.append('entry.1681143871', Math.round(meanConf));
  fetch(FORM_URL, {method: 'POST', mode: 'no-cors', body: data}).then(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Submitted!'; btn.className = 'btn btn-success btn-lg'; }
    getPercentile(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions);
  }).catch(() => {
    scoreSubmitted = true;
    if (btn) { btn.textContent = 'Score saved locally'; btn.className = 'btn btn-info btn-lg'; }
  });
}

function interpolatePercentile(scorePct, group) {
  const p = group.percentiles, s = group.scores_pct;
  for (let i = s.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (scorePct >= s[i]) return p[i]; }
  return 0;
}

function getPercentile(score, total, difficulty, nQuestions) {
  const pct = score / total * 100;
  const meanConf = computeMeanConfidence();
  fetch(STATS_URL).then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(); return r.json(); })
  .then(stats => {
    const d = stats.acute;
    let msg = 'You scored better than ' + interpolatePercentile(pct, d.overall) + '% of all players';
    const key = (difficulty || 'mixed') + '_' + (nQuestions || 5);
    const sub = d.by_config[key];
    if (sub && sub.n >= 10) msg += ' (' + interpolatePercentile(pct, sub) + '% of ' + difficulty + '/' + nQuestions + 'Q players)';
    msg += '! (' + d.overall.n + ' submissions)';
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = msg;
    renderCalibrationComparison(d.calibration, meanConf, pct);
  }).catch(() => {
    // Fallback to live Sheet
    const el = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
    if (el) el.textContent = 'Loading rankings...';
    fetch(SHEET_URL).then(r => r.text()).then(text => {
      const json = JSON.parse(text.replace(/.*google\.visualization\.Query\.setResponse\(/, '').replace(/\);$/, ''));
      let below = 0;
      json.table.rows.forEach(row => {
        const s = row.c[0] ? row.c[0].v : 0, t = row.c[1] ? row.c[1].v : 10;
        if ((s / t * 100) < pct) below++;
      });
      const percentile = json.table.rows.length > 0 ? Math.round(below / json.table.rows.length * 100) : 50;
      if (el) el.textContent = 'You scored better than ' + percentile + '% of players! (' + json.table.rows.length + ' submissions)';
    }).catch(() => { if (el) el.textContent = 'Score submitted! Rankings unavailable right now.'; });
    // quiz_stats.json (the only source of population calibration data) was
    // unreachable here, so there is nothing to compare against — leave the
    // population calibration section hidden rather than showing a broken chart.
  });
}

// ---- Population confidence-calibration comparison (Phase 2 of #132) ----
// SIMPLIFICATION: the population "calibration score" compared against here
// is a coarse, ATTEMPT-level approximation of a Brier score —
// (mean_confidence/100 - score_pct/100)^2 — computed server-side in
// plan_leaderboard_stats.R from the single confidence value the Form
// accepts per submission. It is not a true per-question Brier score; the
// real per-question version stays self-only (see computeCalibration()
// above and quiz_analytics.qmd's "Calibration" section).

// Generic descending-is-better percentile lookup: returns the percentile
// of the population whose value is <= `value` (population as-good-or-better
// than `value` when LOWER values are better, e.g. a calibration score).
function percentileOfAscending(value, percentiles, values) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || values.length === 0) return 0;
  for (let i = values.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { if (value >= values[i]) return percentiles[i]; }
  return 0;
}

function renderCalibrationScatter(points, myConf, myScorePct) {
  const W = 320, H = 320, PAD = { l: 34, r: 12, t: 12, b: 32 };
  const innerW = W - PAD.l - PAD.r, innerH = H - PAD.t - PAD.b;
  function xPos(v) { return PAD.l + innerW * (Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v)) / 100); }
  function yPos(v) { return PAD.t + innerH * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(100, v)) / 100); }

  const grid = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100].map(function(v) {
    const gx = xPos(v), gy = yPos(v);
    return '<line x1="' + PAD.l + '" y1="' + gy + '" x2="' + (W - PAD.r) + '" y2="' + gy + '" stroke="#2a2a4e" stroke-width="1"/>' +
           '<line x1="' + gx + '" y1="' + PAD.t + '" x2="' + gx + '" y2="' + (H - PAD.b) + '" stroke="#2a2a4e" stroke-width="1"/>' +
           '<text x="' + (PAD.l - 4) + '" y="' + (gy + 3) + '" text-anchor="end" fill="#6677aa" font-size="9">' + v + '</text>' +
           '<text x="' + gx + '" y="' + (H - PAD.b + 12) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#6677aa" font-size="9">' + v + '</text>';
  }).join('');

  // Perfect-calibration reference line (confidence == score)
  const diag = '<line x1="' + xPos(0) + '" y1="' + yPos(0) + '" x2="' + xPos(100) + '" y2="' + yPos(100) +
    '" stroke="#3a4e7c" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>';

  const popDots = points.map(function(p) {
    return '<circle class="chart-dot" cx="' + xPos(p.confidence_pct) + '" cy="' + yPos(p.score_pct) +
      '" r="3.5" fill="#5b9de5" fill-opacity="0.55"><title>Confidence ' + Math.round(p.confidence_pct) +
      '%, score ' + Math.round(p.score_pct) + '%</title></circle>';
  }).join('');

  const myDot = '<circle cx="' + xPos(myConf) + '" cy="' + yPos(myScorePct) +
    '" r="7" fill="#ffbe4d" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="1.5"><title>You: ' + Math.round(myConf) +
    '% confident, ' + Math.round(myScorePct) + '% correct</title></circle>';

  const axisLabels =
    '<text x="' + (PAD.l + innerW / 2) + '" y="' + (H - 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8899bb" font-size="10">Mean confidence (%)</text>' +
    '<text x="10" y="' + (PAD.t + innerH / 2) + '" text-anchor="middle" fill="#8899bb" font-size="10" transform="rotate(-90 10 ' + (PAD.t + innerH / 2) + ')">Score (%)</text>';

  return '<svg class="history-chart" viewBox="0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H + '" style="width:100%;max-width:320px;display:block;margin:0 auto;">' +
    grid + diag + popDots + myDot + axisLabels + '</svg>';
}

function renderCalibrationComparison(dCalib, meanConf, myScorePct) {
  const section = document.getElementById('pop_calibration_section');
  const body = document.getElementById('pop_calibration_body');
  if (!section || !body) return;
  // No confidence rated this attempt -- nothing to compare, leave hidden.
  if (meanConf === null || meanConf === undefined) return;

  const popN = (dCalib && dCalib.n) || 0;
  if (popN < 5) {
    section.style.display = '';
    body.innerHTML = '<p style="color:#8899bb;font-size:0.85rem;">Not enough population confidence data yet ' +
      '(need 5+ rated attempts, have ' + popN + '). Check back soon!</p>';
    return;
  }

  const myCalibScore = Math.pow(meanConf / 100 - myScorePct / 100, 2);
  const q = dCalib.quantiles;
  const belowOrEqualPct = percentileOfAscending(myCalibScore, q.percentiles, q.calibration_scores);
  const betterThanPct = Math.max(0, 100 - belowOrEqualPct);

  section.style.display = '';
  body.innerHTML =
    '<p style="color:#8899bb;font-size:0.85rem;margin-bottom:0.75rem;">Your calibration score (' +
    myCalibScore.toFixed(3) + ') is better than ~' + Math.round(betterThanPct) + '% of the ' + popN +
    ' players who rated their confidence. Lower is better — 0 means your mean confidence exactly matched ' +
    'your score. This compares your <em>attempt-level</em> mean confidence against your score, a coarser ' +
    'measure than the per-question calibration in your local ' +
    '<a href="quiz_analytics.html">Quiz Analytics</a>.</p>' +
    renderCalibrationScatter(dCalib.points || [], meanConf, myScorePct);
}

// ---- Local score/confidence history (Phase 1 of #132) ----
// Additive to the micromort_quiz_history schema shared with the Shinylive
// quiz variants ({date, type, score, correct, total}); confidences/outcomes
// are only added when at least one question was rated, so older entries and
// entries from other quiz pages are unaffected. This is browser-local only —
// no confidence data is sent to the Form/Sheet/leaderboard pipeline.
// `difficulties` (#184) is additive in the same way: only recorded when at
// least one question carried a difficulty label.
function recordScoreHistory(quizType, scorePct, score, total, confidences, outcomes, difficulties) {
  const HISTORY_KEY = 'micromort_quiz_history';
  let hist;
  try { hist = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_KEY) || '[]'); } catch (e) { hist = []; }
  const entry = { date: new Date().toISOString(), type: quizType, score: scorePct, correct: score, total: total };
  if (Array.isArray(confidences) && confidences.some(c => c !== null && c !== undefined)) {
    entry.confidences = confidences;
    entry.outcomes = outcomes;
  }
  if (Array.isArray(difficulties) && difficulties.some(d => d !== null && d !== undefined)) {
    entry.difficulties = difficulties;
  }
  hist.push(entry);
  if (hist.length > 200) hist = hist.slice(-200);
  try { localStorage.setItem(HISTORY_KEY, JSON.stringify(hist)); } catch (e) { /* localStorage unavailable/full */ }
}

// ---- "My Progress" view (#185 quick win) ----
// Reads the existing micromort_quiz_history localStorage object (already
// written by recordScoreHistory() above) and renders the user's own past
// attempts on THIS quiz type, most recent first, capped at 20 rows. Purely
// local/same-device -- no server round trip, no new schema.
function renderMyProgressTable(quizType) {
  const HISTORY_KEY = 'micromort_quiz_history';
  let hist;
  try { hist = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(HISTORY_KEY) || '[]'); } catch (e) { hist = []; }
  const mine = Array.isArray(hist) ? hist.filter(function(e) { return e && e.type === quizType; }) : [];
  if (mine.length === 0) {
    return '<p style="color:#8899bb;font-size:0.85rem;">No past attempts recorded yet on this device.</p>';
  }
  const recent = mine.slice(-20).reverse();
  const rows = recent.map(function(e) {
    const d = new Date(e.date);
    const dateStr = isNaN(d.getTime()) ? escHtml(String(e.date)) :
      d.toLocaleDateString() + ' ' + d.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit'});
    const scorePct = Math.round(e.score);
    let meanConf = '—';
    if (Array.isArray(e.confidences)) {
      const rated = e.confidences.filter(function(c) { return c !== null && c !== undefined; });
      if (rated.length > 0) {
        meanConf = Math.round(rated.reduce(function(a, b) { return a + b; }, 0) / rated.length) + '%';
      }
    }
    return '<tr><td>' + dateStr + '</td><td>' + scorePct + '%</td><td>' + meanConf + '</td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  return '<div class="detail-scroll"><table class="table table-striped table-hover detail-table" style="font-size:0.85rem;">' +
    '<thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Score</th><th>Mean confidence</th></tr></thead>' +
    '<tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table></div>' +
    '<p style="color:#8899bb;font-size:0.8rem;margin-top:0.5rem;">Showing your ' + recent.length +
    ' most recent attempt' + (recent.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' on this quiz, on this device/browser only.</p>';
}

// ---- Streak tracking (ported from the retired Shinylive quizzes, 2026-09-05) ----
// Shares its localStorage keys with the other two quiz pages, so a streak
// is per-site (any quiz played counts), matching the prior Shinylive behavior.
function localDateKey(d) {
  const y = d.getFullYear();
  const m = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return y + '-' + m + '-' + day;
}
function updateStreakDisplay(scorePct) {
  const STREAK_KEY = 'micromort_quiz_streak';
  const LAST_PLAY_KEY = 'micromort_quiz_last_play';
  const BEST_KEY = 'micromort_quiz_best_score';
  const now = new Date();
  const today = localDateKey(now);
  const yestD = new Date(); yestD.setDate(yestD.getDate() - 1);
  const yest = localDateKey(yestD);
  const lastPlay = localStorage.getItem(LAST_PLAY_KEY);
  let streak = parseInt(localStorage.getItem(STREAK_KEY) || '0', 10);
  if (lastPlay === today) {
    if (streak === 0) streak = 1;
  } else if (lastPlay === yest) {
    streak = streak + 1;
  } else {
    streak = 1;
  }
  localStorage.setItem(STREAK_KEY, streak);
  localStorage.setItem(LAST_PLAY_KEY, today);
  let best = parseFloat(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY) || '0');
  if (scorePct > best) {
    best = scorePct;
    localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, best);
  }
  const el = document.getElementById('streak_display');
  if (!el) return;
  const streakHtml = streak > 1 ? '<span style="font-size:1.2rem;">&#x1F525; Streak: ' + streak + ' days</span>' : '';
  let msg = '';
  if (scorePct <= 33) msg = 'Keep learning! Try again to improve.';
  else if (scorePct <= 66) msg = "Good effort! You're getting better.";
  else if (scorePct < 100) msg = 'Great job! Almost perfect.';
  else msg = 'Perfect score! &#x1F3AF;';
  const bestHtml = best > 0 ? ' &middot; Best: ' + Math.round(best) + '%' : '';
  el.innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;margin:8px 0;">' +
    (streakHtml ? '<div>' + streakHtml + '</div>' : '') +
    '<div style="margin-top:4px;">' + msg + bestHtml + '</div></div>';
}

function recordCompletedQuiz() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let score = 0;
  const outcomes = [];
  const difficulties = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const correct = S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer;
    if (correct) score++;
    outcomes.push(S.answers[i] === null ? null : (correct ? 1 : 0));
    difficulties.push(S.pairs[i].difficulty || null);
  }
  recordScoreHistory('acute', score / n * 100, score, n, S.confidences, outcomes, difficulties);
}

// ---- Anonymous device ID (#185) ----
// Persistent, anonymous per-browser identifier, shared across all 3 quiz
// pages via the same localStorage key -- generated once, then reused.
// Not yet submitted anywhere (see the commented-out data.append(...) stub
// in submitScore() above); generated and stored now so it's ready the
// moment a Google Form field exists to receive it.
function getAnonId() {
  const KEY = 'micromort_anon_id';
  let id;
  try { id = localStorage.getItem(KEY); } catch (e) { id = null; }
  if (!id) {
    id = (typeof crypto !== 'undefined' && crypto.randomUUID)
      ? crypto.randomUUID()
      : 'anon-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, id); } catch (e) { /* localStorage unavailable */ }
  }
  return id;
}

// Self-only calibration: predicted score (confidence-weighted expectation)
// and Brier score over the questions the participant rated a confidence for.
function computeCalibration() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let rated = 0, predicted = 0, brierSum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const conf = S.confidences[i];
    if (conf === null || conf === undefined) continue;
    const frac = conf / 100;
    const outcome = (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) ? 1 : 0;
    predicted += frac;
    brierSum += Math.pow(frac - outcome, 2);
    rated++;
  }
  return { rated, predicted, brier: rated > 0 ? brierSum / rated : null };
}

// ---- Result phrases ----
const PHRASES = [
  {min: 95, phrase: 'Actuarial genius!', fact: 'Actuaries quantify risk for a living.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Actuary'},
  {min: 90, phrase: 'You think in micromorts!', fact: 'A micromort is a one-in-a-million chance of death.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Micromort'},
  {min: 80, phrase: 'Sharp intuition!', fact: 'Humans tend to overestimate dramatic risks and underestimate common ones.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Risk_perception'},
  {min: 70, phrase: 'Better than a coin toss!', fact: 'We judge risk by how easily examples come to mind.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Availability_heuristic'},
  {min: 60, phrase: 'Getting there!', fact: 'Losses loom larger than gains in our risk calculus.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prospect_theory'},
  {min: 50, phrase: 'About average!', fact: 'Ignoring base rates is one of the most common reasoning errors.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Base_rate_fallacy'},
  {min: 30, phrase: 'Surprises everywhere!', fact: 'We tend to assume things will keep going as normal.', link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Normalcy_bias'},
  {min: -1, phrase: 'Toss a coin — less risky!', fact: "Past outcomes don't change future probabilities.", link: 'https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gambler%27s_fallacy'}
];
function getPhrase(pct) { return PHRASES.find(p => pct >= p.min) || PHRASES[PHRASES.length - 1]; }

const ENCOURAGEMENTS = [
  "Go on, your inner actuary is dying to play. (Not literally.)",
  "Warning: may cause sudden urge to recalculate your commute.",
  "Spoiler: everything is riskier than you think.",
  "No micromorts were harmed in the making of this quiz.",
  "Side effects may include newfound respect for seatbelts.",
  "Think you know risk? Prove it.",
  "Your overconfidence is showing. Let's test it.",
  "Statistically, you'll enjoy this. Probably."
];

// ---- Render functions ----
function render() {
  // Issue #142 (attempt 5): tie visibility of the pkgdown Source line /
  // Shinylive banner / site footer to actual quiz state, not DOM position.
  // pkgdown/extra.css hides them via body:has(#quiz-app):not(.quiz-results);
  // this class is set here, on every render(), so it always reflects S.phase.
  document.body.classList.toggle('quiz-results', S.phase === 'results_summary' || S.phase === 'results_detail');
  const app = document.getElementById('quiz-app');
  switch (S.phase) {
    case 'instructions': app.innerHTML = renderInstructions(); renderQR('qr-instructions', 3); break;
    case 'question': app.innerHTML = renderQuestion(); break;
    case 'results_summary': app.innerHTML = renderResults(); renderQR('qr-results', 3); updateStreakDisplay(S.lastScorePct); break;
    case 'results_detail': app.innerHTML = renderDetail(); break;
  }
}

function renderInstructions() {
  const enc = ENCOURAGEMENTS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ENCOURAGEMENTS.length)];
  return `
    <div class="card"><div class="card-body">
      <ul class="mb-1">
        <li>Each question shows <b><em>two risky activities</em></b>.</li>
        <li>Tap the activity that you think is <b><em>riskier</em></b>.</li>
        <li>You can <b><em>skip</em></b> questions or go <b><em>back</em></b> and review previous answers.</li>
        <li>Skipped (unanswered) questions score zero.</li>
        <li>A <b><em>micromort (mm)</em></b> is a one-in-a-million chance of death.</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="mb-1" style="padding-left:1.5em;"><em>${enc}</em></div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label">Difficulty</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_diff">
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='easy';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Easy</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='medium';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Medium</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selDifficulty='hard';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Hard</button>
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selDifficulty='mixed';selectInGroup('grp_diff',this)">Mixed</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="option-row">
        <span class="option-label">Questions</span>
        <div class="option-btn-group" id="grp_nq">
          <button class="option-btn selected" onclick="S.selNq=5;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">5</button>
          <button class="option-btn" onclick="S.selNq=10;selectInGroup('grp_nq',this)">10</button>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="text-center mt-3">
        <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="startQuiz()">Start Quiz</button>
      </div>
      <div id="qr-instructions"></div>
    </div></div>`;
}

function startQuiz() {
  let pool = S.selDifficulty !== 'mixed'
    ? quizPool.filter(p => p.difficulty === S.selDifficulty)
    : [...quizPool];

  // Exclude seen pairs
  pool = pool.filter(p => {
    const key = [p.activity_a, p.activity_b].sort().join('|||');
    return !S.seenKeys.has(key);
  });
  if (pool.length < S.selNq) { S.seenKeys.clear(); pool = S.selDifficulty !== 'mixed' ? quizPool.filter(p => p.difficulty === S.selDifficulty) : [...quizPool]; }

  const n = Math.min(S.selNq, pool.length);
  S.nQuestions = n;
  S.pairs = shuffle(pool).slice(0, n);
  S.pairs.forEach(p => S.seenKeys.add([p.activity_a, p.activity_b].sort().join('|||')));
  S.answers = new Array(n).fill(null);
  S.confidences = new Array(n).fill(null);
  S.displayOrder = S.pairs.map(() => Math.random() < 0.5 ? ['a','b'] : ['b','a']);
  S.revealed = new Array(n).fill(false);
  S.currentQ = 0;
  S.phase = 'question';
  render();
}

function renderQuestion() {
  const q = S.currentQ, n = S.nQuestions, pair = S.pairs[q];
  const ord = S.displayOrder[q], revealed = S.revealed[q], answer = S.answers[q];
  const awaitingConfidence = answer !== null && !revealed;
  const L = ord[0], R = ord[1];

  function side(s) {
    return {
      activity: pair['activity_' + s], category: pair['category_' + s],
      mm: pair['micromorts_' + s], period: pair['period_' + s],
      desc: pair['description_' + s], help: pair['help_url_' + s]
    };
  }
  const left = side(L), right = side(R);

  function btnClass(s, isRiskier) {
    if (!revealed) {
      if (answer === s) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-neutral';
      return 'quiz-btn';
    }
    if (isRiskier) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-correct';
    if (answer === s) return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-wrong';
    return 'quiz-btn quiz-btn-neutral';
  }
  const leftRiskier = left.mm > right.mm, rightRiskier = right.mm > left.mm;

  function btnContent(d, s, cls) {
    const mmText = revealed ? `<strong style="font-size:1.4rem;color:#333;">${fmtMM(d.mm)} mm</strong>` : '';
    const helpLink = d.help ? `<a class="help-link" href="${escHtml(safeHref(d.help))}" target="_blank" onclick="event.stopPropagation()">Learn more →</a>` : '';
    const clickAttr = (answer === null) ? `onclick="choose('${s}')"` : '';
    const dimStyle = (awaitingConfidence && answer !== s) ? ' style="opacity:0.5"' : '';
    return `<div class="${cls}" ${clickAttr}${dimStyle}>
      <span class="activity-name">${formatName(escHtml(d.activity))}</span>
      <div><span class="badge bg-secondary me-1">${escHtml(d.category)}</span><span class="badge" style="background:#0dcaf0;color:#000">${escHtml(d.period)}</span></div>
      ${mmText}${helpLink}
    </div>`;
  }

  // Result text
  let resultHtml = '';
  if (revealed) {
    const correct = pair.answer;
    const userCorrect = answer === correct;
    if (answer === null) {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger text-center mt-2 py-2">Skipped! ${escHtml(pair['activity_' + correct])} is riskier.</div>`;
    } else if (userCorrect) {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-success text-center mt-2 py-2"><strong>Correct!</strong></div>`;
    } else {
      resultHtml = `<div class="alert alert-danger text-center mt-2 py-2"><strong>Incorrect!</strong> ${escHtml(pair['activity_' + correct])} is riskier.</div>`;
    }
    // Explanation
    const riskier = pair.answer, safer = riskier === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a';
    resultHtml += `<div class="explanation-panel mt-2">
      <p><strong>${escHtml(pair['activity_' + riskier])}</strong> has ${fmtMM(pair['micromorts_' + riskier])} mm: ${escHtml(pair['description_' + riskier] || '')}</p>
      <p><strong>${escHtml(pair['activity_' + safer])}</strong> has ${fmtMM(pair['micromorts_' + safer])} mm: ${escHtml(pair['description_' + safer] || '')}</p>
      <p>${escHtml(pair['activity_' + riskier])} is ${pair.ratio.toFixed(1)}x riskier than ${escHtml(pair['activity_' + safer])}.</p>
    </div>`;
  }

  // Confidence capture (Phase 1 of #132: self-only, no server persistence)
  let confidenceHtml = '';
  if (awaitingConfidence) {
    const confOptions = [0, 25, 50, 75, 100];
    confidenceHtml = `<div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small class="text-muted d-block mb-1">How confident were you in that pick?</small>
      <div class="option-btn-group justify-content-center" id="grp_conf">
        ${confOptions.map(pct => `<button class="option-btn" onclick="chooseConfidence(${pct}, this)">${pct}%</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  } else if (revealed && S.confidences[q] !== null && S.confidences[q] !== undefined) {
    confidenceHtml = `<div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small class="text-muted">Your confidence: <strong>${S.confidences[q]}%</strong></small>
    </div>`;
  }

  // Tally
  let correctSoFar = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i <= q; i++) { if (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) correctSoFar++; }
  const answered = S.revealed.filter(Boolean).length;

  const diffBadge = (() => {
    const d = pair.difficulty;
    if (!d) return '';
    const colors = {easy:'background:#198754;color:#fff', medium:'background:#b85c0a;color:#fff', hard:'background:#dc3545;color:#fff'};
    const style = colors[d] || 'background:#6c757d;color:#fff';
    return `<span class="badge me-2" style="${style}">${escHtml(d)}</span>`;
  })();

  const nextBtnClass = revealed ? 'btn btn-success' : 'btn btn-primary';
  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-3">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="prevQ()">← Back</button>
      <span class="text-muted">${diffBadge}${q+1} of ${n} · <small>Score: ${correctSoFar}/${answered} correct</small></span>
      <button class="${nextBtnClass}" onclick="nextQ()">${q === n-1 ? 'Finish' : 'Next →'}</button>
    </div>
    <div class="quiz-row">
      <div class="quiz-col">${btnContent(left, L, btnClass(L, L === pair.answer))}</div>
      <div class="quiz-vs"><h3 class="text-muted mb-0">VS</h3></div>
      <div class="quiz-col">${btnContent(right, R, btnClass(R, R === pair.answer))}</div>
    </div>
    ${resultHtml}${confidenceHtml}`;
}

function choose(side) {
  S.answers[S.currentQ] = side;
  render();
}
function chooseConfidence(pct, el) {
  S.confidences[S.currentQ] = pct;
  S.revealed[S.currentQ] = true;
  render();
}
function nextQ() {
  if (S.currentQ < S.nQuestions - 1) { S.currentQ++; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'results_summary'; recordCompletedQuiz(); render(); }
}
function prevQ() {
  if (S.currentQ > 0) { S.currentQ--; render(); }
  else { S.phase = 'instructions'; render(); }
}

function renderResults() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let score = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (S.answers[i] !== null && S.answers[i] === S.pairs[i].answer) score++; }
  const pct = score / n * 100, baseline = (n / 2).toFixed(1);
  S.lastScorePct = pct;
  const info = getPhrase(pct);
  const calib = computeCalibration();
  const calibHtml = calib.rated > 0 ? `
    <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-info"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Predicted (your confidence)</small><h2 class="mb-0">${calib.predicted.toFixed(1)} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mb-3">
      <small class="text-muted">Your Brier score: <strong>${calib.brier.toFixed(3)}</strong> — lower is better calibrated (0 = perfect, 0.25 = "always say 50%" baseline)${calib.rated < n ? ` · based on ${calib.rated}/${n} rated question${calib.rated === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : ''}</small>
    </div>` : '';

  return `
    <h2 class="text-center mb-4">Results</h2>
    <div style="display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:1rem;">
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-primary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Your Score</small><h2 class="mb-0">${score} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
      <div style="flex:1;"><div class="card text-white bg-secondary"><div class="card-body text-center">
        <small>Random Guessing</small><h2 class="mb-0">~${baseline} / ${n}</h2>
      </div></div></div>
    </div>
    <div id="streak_display"></div>
    ${calibHtml}
    <div class="analytics-section" id="pop_calibration_section" style="display:none;">
      <h3>Calibration vs. other players</h3>
      <div id="pop_calibration_body"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mb-4">
      <h3>${info.phrase}</h3>
      <em>${info.fact}</em><br>
      <a href="${info.link}" target="_blank">Learn more →</a>
    </div>
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-center gap-3">
      <button id="submit_btn" class="btn btn-lg" style="background:#b85c0a;color:#fff" onclick="submitScore(${score},${n},'${S.selDifficulty}',${S.selNq})">Submit Score</button>
      <button id="share_btn" class="btn btn-success btn-lg" onclick="shareResult(${score},${n})">Share</button>
      <button class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-lg" onclick="S.phase='results_detail';render()">View Details</button>
      <button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="text-center mt-2">
      <small id="percentile_text" class="text-muted"></small><br>
      <small class="text-muted">Scores are recorded anonymously (score, total, timestamp, and — if you rated any answers — your mean confidence for this attempt only).</small>
    </div>
    <div id="qr-results"></div>
    <details style="margin-top:1rem;">
      <summary style="cursor:pointer;">View my history</summary>
      <div class="analytics-section" style="margin-top:0.5rem;">
        <h3>My Progress</h3>
        <div id="my_progress_body">${renderMyProgressTable('acute')}</div>
      </div>
    </details>`;
}

function shareResult(score, n) {
  const pEl = document.getElementById('percentile_text');
  const pLine = pEl && pEl.textContent ? '\n' + pEl.textContent + '\n' : '\n';
  const text = '☠️ Micromort Quiz: I scored ' + score + '/' + n + '!' + pLine +
    'Which lifestyle event is more likely to kill you?\n' +
    'Can you beat my score? ☠️\n' +
    'https://johngavin.github.io/micromort/articles/micromort-quiz.html';
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(() => {
    const btn = document.getElementById('share_btn');
    btn.textContent = 'Copied!';
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'Share'; }, 2000);
  });
}

function renderDetail() {
  const n = S.nQuestions;
  let rows = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const p = S.pairs[i], ans = S.answers[i];
    const userAns = ans === null ? 'Skipped' : escHtml(p['activity_' + ans]);
    const correctAns = escHtml(p['activity_' + p.answer]);
    const result = ans === null ? '—' : (ans === p.answer ? '✓' : '✗');
    const linkA = p.help_url_a ? `<a href="${escHtml(safeHref(p.help_url_a))}" target="_blank">${escHtml(p.activity_a)}</a>` : escHtml(p.activity_a);
    const linkB = p.help_url_b ? `<a href="${escHtml(safeHref(p.help_url_b))}" target="_blank">${escHtml(p.activity_b)}</a>` : escHtml(p.activity_b);
    rows += `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${linkA}</td><td>${fmtMM(p.micromorts_a)}</td>
      <td>${linkB}</td><td>${fmtMM(p.micromorts_b)}</td>
      <td>${userAns}</td><td>${correctAns}</td><td>${result}</td></tr>`;
  }
  return `
    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center mb-4">
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="S.phase='results_summary';render()">← Back to Results</button>
      <h3 class="mb-0">Your quiz details</h3>
      <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="resetLeaderboard();S.phase='instructions';render()">Try Again</button>
    </div>
    <div class="detail-scroll">
      <table class="table table-striped table-hover detail-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Q</th><th>Activity A</th><th>mm A</th><th>Activity B</th><th>mm B</th><th>Your Answer</th><th>Correct</th><th>Result</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>${rows}</tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
}

// ---- Init ----
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  loadData();
  getAnonId();
  render();
});
</script>
```
